display_long_description:
Drift V is a fast, comfort-focused VR drift racer built for Meta Quest, blending arcade speed with true sideways control.

Become a drift legend across 12 adrenaline-fueled levels, from neon streets and sharp mountain turns to high-speed stunt sections built for clean lines, precise counter-steer, and satisfying tire-screeching slides.

Unlock and master 9 drift cars, each made for a different driving feel. Tune your rides, improve performance, and push harder for faster scores, cleaner drifts, and better race times. Battle pro AI rivals, chase global leaderboard spots, and prove you can hold the perfect line under pressure.

Cinematic cutscenes make each milestone feel bigger, while smooth controls keep the action comfortable for Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest Pro players.

Features:
• 9 free drift cars
• 12 sideways drift levels
• Realistic VR physics and weight shift
• AI drift rivals
• Upgrades and customization
• Cinematic cutscenes
• Meta Quest optimized
• Smooth comfort-focused gameplay

Search Drift V on Meta Horizon Store and start your drift legend journey.
